item.title: Solved: How to Choose Between Qt Threads and Python Threads in PyQt Applications
item.description:
Question

I am developing a GUI application using PyQt that needs to regularly fetch data over a web connection. Unfortunately, this retrieval process can take a considerable amount of time, rendering the UI unresponsive during these operations. Given that the process cannot be easily segmented into smaller tasks, I am considering offloading the web connection handling to a worker thread to maintain UI responsiveness.

As I am utilizing PyQt4 for this project, I am confronted with a pivotal decision: should I employ Qt’s threading capabilities or rely on Python’s built-in threading module? What are the pros and cons of each approach? Are there alternative methods or best practices for managing this scenario that I may not be aware of?
